blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — Philippine bet Bea Millan-Windorski ended her Miss Universe 2026 journey as the third runner-up of the 75th edition of the international pageant on Wednesday, Nov. 25 (Philippine time) in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The 24-year-old La Union beauty secured a spot in the top 5 alongside first runner-up Melissa Núñez of the Dominican Republic, second runner-up Clara Vega of Venezuela, and fourth runner-up Georgia Waddington of New Zealand. During the evening gown competition, Millan-Windorski wore a custom ivory gown by Filipino designer Anthony Ramirez titled, “Pearl of the Orient.” READ: Bea Millan-Windorski’s Miss Universe bid gets La Union’s […]...
